Written by hand.
A module that generates part of its own API and carries no go.mod, the way
golang.org/x/text did before it had one. The go command synthesizes its
go.mod; the zip holds only the source.

The path is the org's. A module with no go.mod has nowhere to write the
opt-in line, so only an org module reaches this path at all.

-- .mod --
module github.com/wow-look-at-my/generatednomod
-- .info --
{"Version": "v1.0.0"}
-- gen/main.go --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "file to write")
	flag.Parse()
	body := "package lang\n\nfunc Name() string { return \"generated\" }\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, []byte(body), 0o666); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- lang/lang.go --
//go:generate go run github.com/wow-look-at-my/generatednomod/gen -out lang.gen.go

// Package lang declares nothing itself: Name is the generator's to write.
package lang
